title: Buddy Petit's swelling neck and other players' cheeks
summary: Souchon describes how Buddy Petit's neck and face puffed out when he blew. Russell compares Armstrong, Brunies and Jim Robinson.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: When he blew he evidently either had, it was a bad embouchure or he was instructed wrong. But his neck would swell way out and one side of his face would puff way out. Now it may have helped him sustain the note, you know, to have all that extra air there. But he looked funny as a dickens.
Well, Louis Armstrong's neck comes out so far and George Brunus' whole face comes out.
And what's the matter with big Jim Robinson? Yeah, he comes out. He's got two pouches on the side of his face that come out.
I think George's face swells out more as the whole face in there. And Louis' neck comes out. Other people's neck, too, have seen it.
